sections.title: Active allocation
sections.sql: select building,floor,people,seats,capacity,spare_seats from floor_load where status='active' order by building,floor

sections.title: Recent observations
sections.sql: select * from occupancy_review order by building,floor
sections.note: Last thirty days only. No observation means unknown, never zero attendance.

sections.title: Scenario exceptions
sections.sql: select e.plan,e.rule,e.subject,e.issue from space_exceptions e join plans p on p.id=e.plan_id where p.status in ('draft','approved') order by e.plan,e.rule

sections.title: Open tasks
sections.sql: select p.name plan,t.name task,t.owner,t.due,t.blocking from move_tasks t join plans p on p.id=t.plan_id where t.status='open' order by t.due

sections.title: Emergency-plan references
sections.sql: select name,owner,emergency_ref,review_due from buildings order by name

sections.title: Capacity evidence
sections.sql: select b.name building,f.name floor,f.capacity,f.capacity_ref from floors f join buildings b on b.id=f.building_id order by b.name,f.name
